description: Usmeritve za urejanje vodotokov in njihovo sanacijo po poplavah (Študija) is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. On 4 August 2023, Slovenia was hit by a heavy storm with several daily precipitations, floods and landslides. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. The portal shows the English title as "Guidelines for the regulation of watercourses and their rehabilitation after floods (Study)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Its keywords include poplave, gravitacijska voda. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
